2026-07-10T14:53:49.9305415Z     local key=$2
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9305609Z     local value=$3
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9305724Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9305811Z     local os=$(uname)
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9306015Z     case $os in
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9306295Z         # Note: in mac os should use sed -i '' "xxx" to replace string,
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9306713Z         # otherwise prompt 'command c expects \ followed by text'.
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9307117Z         # See http://www.cnblogs.com/greedy-day/p/5952899.html
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9307479Z         Darwin) sed -i '' "s!$key=.*!$key=$value!g" "$file" ;;
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9307812Z         *) sed -i "s!$key=.*!$key=$value!g" "$file" ;;
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9308084Z     esac

2026-07-10T14:53:49.9324142Z # wait_for_startup friendly_name host port timeout_s
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9324457Z function wait_for_startup() {
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9324693Z     local pid="$1"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9324897Z     local server_name="$2"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9325123Z     local server_url="$3"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9325382Z     local timeout_s="$4"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9325602Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9325701Z     local now_s=$(date '+%s')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9325945Z     local stop_s=$((now_s + timeout_s))
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9326126Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9326216Z     local status
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9326439Z     local error_file_name="startup_error.txt"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9326625Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9326778Z     echo -n "Connecting to $server_name ($server_url)"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9327120Z     while [ "$now_s" -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9327520Z         echo -n .
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9327903Z         process_status "$server_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9328391Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9328807Z             echo "Starting $server_name failed"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9329110Z             if [ -e "$error_file_name" ]; then

2026-07-10T14:53:49.9335171Z function free_memory() {
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9335397Z     local free=""
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9335600Z     local os=$(uname)
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9335812Z     if [ "$os" == "Linux" ]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9336170Z         local mem_free=$(cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "MemFree" | awk '{print $2}')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9336661Z         local mem_buffer=$(cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Buffers" | awk '{print $2}')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9337141Z         local mem_cached=$(cat /proc/meminfo | grep -w "Cached" | awk '{print $2}')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9337586Z         if [[ "$mem_free" == "" || "$mem_buffer" == "" || "$mem_cached" == "" ]]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9337947Z             echo "Failed to get free memory"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9338206Z             exit 1
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9338395Z         fi
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9338639Z         free=$(expr "$mem_free" + "$mem_buffer" + "$mem_cached")
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9338956Z         free=$(expr "$free" / 1024)
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9339207Z     elif [ "$os" == "Darwin" ]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9339728Z         local pages_free=$(vm_stat | awk '/Pages free/{print $0}' | awk -F'[:.]+' '{print $2}' | tr -d " ")

2026-07-10T14:53:49.9340884Z         local pages_available=$(expr "$pages_free" + "$pages_inactive")
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9341273Z         free=$(expr "$pages_available" \* 4096 / 1024 / 1024)
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9341716Z     else
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9341973Z         echo "Unsupported operating system $os"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9342247Z         exit 1
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9342433Z     fi
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9342612Z     echo "$free"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9342801Z }

2026-07-10T14:53:49.9342985Z function calc_xmx() {
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9343204Z     local min_mem=$1
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9343406Z     local max_mem=$2
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9343617Z     # Get machine available memory
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9343878Z     local free=$(free_memory)
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9344118Z     local half_free=$((free/2))
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9344267Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9344355Z     local xmx=$min_mem
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9344580Z     if [[ "$free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9344830Z         exit 1
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9345055Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -ge "$max_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9345321Z         xmx=$max_mem
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9345717Z     elif [[ "$half_free" -lt "$min_mem" ]]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9345980Z         xmx=$min_mem
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9346171Z     else
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9346352Z         xmx=$half_free
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9346547Z     fi
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9346722Z     echo $xmx
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9346903Z }

2026-07-10T14:53:49.9375166Z function wait_for_shutdown() {
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9375412Z     local process_name="$1"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9375642Z     local pid="$2"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9375854Z     local timeout_s="$3"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9375997Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9376086Z     local now_s=$(date '+%s')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9376331Z     local stop_s=$((now_s + timeout_s))
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9376504Z 
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9376628Z     echo -n "Killing $process_name(pid $pid)" >&2
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9376927Z     while [ "$now_s" -le $stop_s ]; do
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9377176Z         echo -n .
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9377415Z         process_status "$process_name" "$pid" >/dev/null
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9377706Z         if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9377926Z             echo "OK"
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9378134Z             return 0
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9378331Z         fi
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9378512Z         sleep 2
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9378711Z         now_s=$(date '+%s')
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9378926Z     done
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9379212Z     echo "$process_name shutdown timeout(exceeded $timeout_s seconds)" >&2
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9379563Z     return 1
2026-07-10T14:53:49.9379746Z }
